title: 第25章 郁金香商会第26章 和他有什么关系
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
离开银月森林后，安东习惯性地运转千面诀，给自己换了一副面孔。
出于谨慎，他没有沿用苍澜的旧身份，而是另塑一副全新面孔。
毕竟苍澜和寂灭之环有过牵扯，指不定已经被后者暗中盯上。
在千岩丘陵狩猎也就算了，可要进入碧水港这种龙蛇混杂之地，还是小心谨慎点为好。
运转星移步全力狂奔下，安东只用了不到一小时，就抵达了碧水港。
高耸的城墙在阳光下显露出饱经风霜的灰褐色，高度超过三十米，由巨大的花岗岩条石砌成，表面爬满岁月侵蚀的斑驳痕迹。
城门洞开，两扇包铁的橡木大门向内敞开，门洞深邃，阳光只能照亮前半段，后半段隐没在阴影中，像一头巨兽微张的嘴。
排队入城的人流蜿蜒如蛇，从城门一直延伸到四五百米外。
安东来到队伍末段，饶有兴致地打量四周。
在银月森林待了几十年，看惯了草木葱茏、光影斑驳，乍一来到这种人流熙攘的地方，有种奇异的恍惚感，仿佛从一幅静谧的油画闯入喧嚣的市井长卷。
队伍缓慢前移，大约过了十多分钟，安东终于来到城门前。
两名身着皮甲的卫兵把守着入口，其中一个面容粗犷的大汉伸手拦下他，上下打量一眼：“入城费，两个铜币。”
安东从腰间摸出两枚铜币递了过去。
那大汉接过，随手丢进身旁的木箱，摆摆手：“进去吧。”
安东迈步穿过门洞，阴影笼罩又褪去，眼前豁然开朗。
一股混杂着海腥味、香料味、汗水味和食物香气的热浪扑面而来，与城外清冷的微风形成鲜明对比。
街道两侧商铺林立，招牌从二层楼檐探出，分别绘着酒杯、麦穗、铁砧与药草等图案，形形色色，令人目不暇接。
人族商贩在摊位前高声叫卖。
兽人搬运工扛着沉重货箱从人群中挤过，露出獠牙的面孔上汗水涔涔，粗壮的脖颈青筋虬结。
几个矮人蹲在铁匠铺门口，就着麦酒啃食黑面包，疤痕交错的手臂随着交谈不时挥舞，发出粗犷的笑声。

不远处，一个身材高大、皮肤呈淡蓝色的鱼人从巷口拐出，脖颈两侧隐约可见鳃裂的痕迹，手里提着一串银光闪烁的海鱼，脚步匆忙地消失在街角人流中。
明明分属不同种族，可所有人却都在这座城市里融洽相处。
眼前这一幕让安东想起了上一世在游戏里的冒险岁月，一时间喟叹不已。
好在他不是多愁善感的性格，很快就调整好心绪，找了个路人问明方向，便朝潮汐街走去。
潮汐街是碧水港最繁华的商业街，许多商会的总部都坐落在这里。
安东放慢脚步，目光在两侧的招牌间逡巡。
很快，他找到了目标。
那是一座三层的石砌建筑，门楣上镶嵌着一朵郁金香的浮雕，花瓣层叠舒展，栩栩如生。
浮雕下方挂着一块铜牌，上面刻着‘郁金香商会’的字样。
按照哈维的说法，郁金香商会是碧水港数一数二的大型商会，整个碧水港只有流火商会能和它掰手腕。
不过比起后者，郁金香商会在冒险者圈子里的名声更佳，做生意更讲究，童叟无欺。
建筑门口站着两个护卫，身披锁子甲，腰悬长剑，目光锐利地扫视着往来行人。
安东整了整衣襟，迈步走上台阶。
左侧的护卫瞥了他一眼，不卑不亢地提醒道：“先生，这里是郁金香商会总部，只负责接待金额100金币以上的大笔交易，如果您只是想购买寻常商品的话，可以前往商会在城里的其他商铺。”
content_en:
After leaving the Silver Moon Forest, Anton used the Thousand Faces Technique to change his face.
Out of caution, he did not adopt Cang Lan's old identity, but instead adopted a new look.
After all, Canglan has been involved with the Ring of Nirvana, and may have been secretly targeted by the latter.
It's okay to hunt in Qianyan Hills, but when entering a place like Bishui Port where dragons and snakes are mixed, it's better to be cautious.
The star moved and ran with all its strength, and Anton arrived at Bishui Port in less than an hour.
The towering city wall reveals a weathered gray-brown color in the sun. It is more than thirty meters high and is made of huge granite stones. Its surface is covered with mottled traces of erosion over time.
The city gate is open, and two iron-clad oak doors open inward. The door opening is deep, and the sunlight can only illuminate the front half, while the back half is hidden in the shadows, like the slightly opened mouth of a giant beast.
The queue of people lining up to enter the city snakes like a snake, stretching from the city gate to four to five hundred meters away.
Anton came to the end of the team and looked around with interest.
After spending decades in Silver Moon Forest, I am used to seeing lush vegetation and mottled light and shadow. When I first came to such a crowded place, I felt a strange sense of trance, as if I had broken into a noisy market scroll from a quiet oil painting.
The team moved forward slowly, and after about ten minutes, Anton finally arrived in front of the city gate.
Two guards in leather armor guarded the entrance. One of them, a rough-looking man, stretched out his hand to stop him and looked him up and down: "The entrance fee is two copper coins."
Anton took out two copper coins from his waist and handed them over.
The big man took it, threw it into the wooden box beside him, and waved his hand: "Go in."
Anton stepped through the doorway, the shadow shrouded and then faded, and his eyes suddenly opened up.
A heat wave mixed with the smell of sea, spices, sweat and food came to my face, in stark contrast to the cool breeze outside the city.
There are many shops on both sides of the street, and the signboards protrude from the eaves of the second floor. They are painted with patterns such as wine glasses, wheat ears, anvils, and medicinal herbs. The various shapes are dizzying.
The human traders shouted loudly in front of the stalls.
The orc porters squeezed through the crowd carrying heavy cargo boxes, sweat dripping from their fangs-bared faces, and veins knotted in their thick necks.
Several dwarves squatted at the door of the blacksmith shop, sipping ale and eating black bread. Their scarred arms waved from time to time as they talked, making rough laughter.
Not far away, a tall fish-man with light blue skin turned out of the alley. Traces of gill slits were faintly visible on both sides of his neck. He was holding a string of silvery sea fish in his hand and disappeared in a hurry into the crowd of people on the street corner.
They obviously belong to different races, but everyone gets along well with each other in this city.
The scene before him reminded Anton of his adventures in the game in his previous life, and he sighed for a moment.
Fortunately, he was not sentimental, so he quickly adjusted his mood, found a passerby to ask for directions, and walked towards Tidal Street.
Tide Street is the most prosperous commercial street in Bishui Port, and the headquarters of many chambers of commerce are located here.
Anton slowed down and looked around at the signs on both sides.
Soon, he found his target.
It was a three-story stone building. The lintel was inlaid with a relief sculpture of a tulip, its petals stacked and stretched out, lifelike.
A bronze plate hangs below the relief with the words 'Tulip Chamber of Commerce' engraved on it.
According to Harvey, the Tulip Chamber of Commerce is one of the top large chambers of commerce in Bishui Port, and only the Liuhuo Chamber of Commerce in the entire Bishui Port can compete with it.
However, compared to the latter, the Tulip Merchant Guild has a better reputation in the adventurer circle, and is more particular about doing business and is honest and honest.
Two guards stood at the door of the building, wearing chainmail armor and swords hanging from their waists, scanning the passers-by with sharp eyes.
Anton straightened his clothes and stepped up the steps.
The guard on the left glanced at him and reminded him in a nonchalant manner: "Sir, this is the headquarters of the Tulip Chamber of Commerce.Responsible for handling large transactions of more than 100 gold coins. If you just want to buy ordinary goods, you can go to other shops of the Chamber of Commerce in the city. "
